description: This file defines a Flutter widget screen named 'MyDay' which displays a list of tasks for the day, allowing users to view, complete, and navigate to task details or add new tasks.

classes.name: MyDay
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the list of tasks for the day and manages the state related to task list, loading status, and navigation.

classes.name: _MyDayState
classes.description: The state class for 'MyDay', handling data fetching, UI updates, task completion toggling, and navigation interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and fetches the task list upon widget creation.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches all tasks from the database and updates the UI state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Returns the widget tree for rendering the 'MyDay' screen, including app bar, task list, and floating action button.
